description: Orca mods tree hash (YouGame docs/ORCA_MODS.md, Phase 1 contract and its adjustments): lowercase hex sha256 of the UTF-8 lines <path>\t<sha256>\t<bytes>\n for every file except orca/jitwarm and anything under orca/test/, in byte order of path. files are as tree.json lists them; hashedText is what is hashed. The same vector is in YouGame's web/src/lib/mod-tree.test.ts and the desktop app's tests.
